sources.name: Niwot Business Association (niwot.com)
sources.notes: The Niwot Business Association's site, added as a source on the owner's word, 20 October 2026. Its calendar (Modern Events Calendar) publishes /events/feed/: one item per event at its next date, with mec:startDate, mec:startHour, mec:endDate, mec:endHour, mec:location and mec:category; the plugin's site-wide iCal feed is switched off. The feed holds ten items, the next ten events in date order, which on 20 October reached July 2027. Filed as chamber, not venue: the board also carries other groups' events, so nothing from it is approved without a person, and another group's event is confirmed on that group's own page. Excluded: the Tree Carving Fundraiser, a donation appeal the calendar repeats every Tuesday with no time or place; Trivia Night, The Wheel House's weekly regular, which the guide lists from the venue; and the Hormone Health Small Group Medical Program, an enrollment clinic program at a day spa, which is a promotion, not an event.

sources.name: Niwot Hall (Left Hand Grange)
sources.notes: The hall's rental calendar (Modern Events Calendar), read 20 October 2026 at /events/feed/: ten items, the coming week only (the plugin ignores paging and its iCal export is off), mixing public events with band practice, rehearsals and private bookings. The hall marks the public ones 'Featured Event', which is the include filter; the Rotary's weekly breakfast is already listed as a regular and the election commission's meetings are civic notices. No location element: the hall is the venue. A one-week window read on Mondays lists that week's talks and seminars; longer notice has to come from the organizers' own pages. Confirmed 20 October 2026 on the owner's delegation; 16 published events already cite the site. "Rebuilding Seminars" excluded 1 November 2026: the hall marks the Sunday 5 to 8 pm sessions a featured event, but they are the ten-week divorce-recovery course, a closed group that enrolls in advance (checked 21 October); the 1 November ingest published one under the rules and it came straight off. The course's public introductory evening is a separate listing.

sources.name: The Wheel House
sources.notes: Added 31 October 2026, when a check for missed Niwot events found the bar's calendar carried a band every Friday and Saturday, a Halloween party and a weekly euchre night, none of them on the guide, which had only its Tuesday trivia (from niwot.com). The calendar is a Squarespace calendar block (collection 67cc8d31ad15874647ad995d) that the page fills by script; the page's own data call, /api/open/GetItemsByMonth?month=MM-YYYY&collectionId=67cc8d31ad15874647ad995d, returns each month's items with start and end, and each item's page answers ?format=json with its description. Ingest has no Squarespace reader, so this is read by hand until one is written. The calendar entries' times are sometimes an hour where the description gives longer (trivia shows 6:30 to 7:30; niwot.com gives 6:30 to 8:30).

sources.name: niwotrotary.org
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Feed found 10 November 2026: the club's site is ClubRunner, and the 'Subscribe to Calendar' button on /events/calendar gives https://www.niwotrotary.org/calendar-feed, which answered 200 text/calendar (124 KB, 110 VEVENT, no RRULE, going back to November 2025) and parsed with the ingest's own iCal reader. Five items fall in 10 November to 9 December: Board Meeting (monthly) 11 Nov 6 pm (a Zoom link, no place), Club Meeting 12 and 19 Nov 7:30 am at Niwot Hall, Domestic Violence Committee Meeting 26 Nov 7:30 am at Old Oak Coffee, 136 2nd Ave, and OUR Center Meal Service 6 Dec 10 am (location 'OUR Center', no address). Seventeen items from today onward. robots.txt (a list of numbered paths) does not disallow /calendar-feed. Needs filtering before it is any use: the weekly Club Meeting is the breakfast the guide already lists as a regular and the board and committee meetings are the club's own business, so excludeTitles 'Club Meeting', 'Board Meeting' and 'Committee Meeting' would leave only the service days and fundraisers, perhaps one a month. Several items carry the club's Zoom link as their URL. Category is still the seeded guess (venue); 'other' fits better.

sources.name: Boulder Public Library District - Gunbarrel Library events
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Not a Niwot venue: Niwot has no library of its own, and no item in the district's feed names Niwot. This is the district branch nearest Niwot, in Gunbarrel (a search result for the calendar's event pages gives 6500 Lookout Rd.; the address was not on the event page read); whether Niwot addresses are inside the Boulder Public Library District was not checked, and whether a Gunbarrel branch belongs on the Niwot guide is the owner's call. The calendar at calendar.boulderlibrary.org is Communico; its feeds are served from boulderlibrary.libnet.info/feeds?data=<base64 JSON of {feedType, filters}> (the same shape Castle Rock's dcl-org uses; the calendar.boulderlibrary.org host answers 404 for /feeds). The all-branches iCal read 200 text/calendar with 500 VEVENT (capped), reaching only to 16 December, 403 of them in the next 30 days across Main, NoBo, Meadows, Reynolds, Gunbarrel and Virtual. The feedUrl here is the same feed limited to location 4559, Gunbarrel Library (the id comes from the calendar's own event data): 161 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, through December 2027, every LOCATION beginning 'Gunbarrel Library - ' with a room or nothing. 35 items in 10 November to 9 December, parsed with the ingest's own iCal reader: about 20 are storytimes (Baby Time, Toddler Storytime, Preschool Storytime, Storytime, Storytime at Gunbarrel), the rest one-offs and monthly groups such as Active Minds: Native Americans of Colorado (16 Nov), Gunbarrel Classic Movies (22 Nov), Shelf Talkers Book Club, Short Story Book Club, Social Stitchers, Tinker Art Studio (30 Nov), Bad Art Night (3 Dec), Winter Baby Rave (5 Dec), Community Chats (7 Dec). Items carry no URL; an event's page is calendar.boulderlibrary.org/event/<UID>. robots.txt on both hosts disallows only /results* and site search, so /feeds is allowed. If confirmed, the storytimes want an excludeTitles list ('Storytime', 'Baby Time') or the guide gets five a week, and defaultVenue 'Gunbarrel Library'. The Longmont Public Library was not added: it is in Longmont and has no Niwot branch.

sources.name: Niwot High School - Niwot Activities & Events calendar
sources.lastNote: feed answers but calendar.google.com robots.txt disallows our agent, and the next 30 days are all student club meetings
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026 so nobody looks twice. The school's home page embeds one public Google calendar, 'Niwot Activities & Events' (svvsd.org_2iseneltdfah8uip6cbfbbafq8@group.calendar.google.com). Its public .ics answered 200 (185 KB, 535 VEVENT, heavily recurring) and parsed with the ingest's own reader: 196 occurrences in 10 November to 9 December, none with a location, and every one a student club meeting (Cyber Patriots, Key Club, Mock Trial, Art Club and so on), a military recruiter visit or a 'Late Start' marker. No concert, play, game or community night is on it in that window. Kept manual for two reasons: calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows unlisted agents (as recorded for Elizabeth's library), and the content is not what the guide lists. The school's concerts, theatre and athletics must be on another calendar; www.svvsd.org answered 429 Too Many Requests to every calendar path tried on 10 November, including /st-vrain-athletic-events-calendar/, so the district's calendars (the existing svvsd-org entry) could not be checked for a feed.

sources.name: Left Hand Valley Courier
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Niwot's weekly paper. Its Events section (/section/events, 200; 'Results 1 - 50 of 244') is news stories about events, newest first, with sub-sections for First Friday Art Walk, Enchanted Evening, Holiday Market, Rock & Rails, Niwot Jazz Festival, Lobsterfest, Honey Bee Harvest Festival, House Blend Band concerts, lectures and others; the top stories on 10 November were the Great Pumpkin Party (31 Oct) and the Historical Society's 21 October Now & Then lecture on the Niwot Cemetery. There is no calendar with dated entries. The site's one feed, https://www.lhvc.com/rss, answered 200 with 30 items, but it is the general news feed with no event dates, so ingest would skip every item; it is not recorded as a feedUrl. robots.txt allows the section for our agent (it blocks named AI crawlers and carries a content signal of search=yes, ai-train=no). For leads and attribution: an event found here is confirmed on the organizer's own page.

sources.name: Inkberry Books
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. The bookshop in Cottonwood Shopping Center (7960 Niwot Road, Suite B-3, (720) 412-1548, from the site's header) holds author evenings and posts them on a hand-written page, 'Events at Inkberry Books'. Read 10 November: two dated events in the next 30 days, 13 November 7 pm (author Mike King, Rocky Mountain Heist) and 21 November 7 pm (not read further), each with an RSVP page. A hand-coded static site with no feed of any kind and no robots.txt. Read by hand; two or three listings a month.

sources.name: Fritz Family Brewers
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Niwot's brewery (the site's title is 'Brewery | Fritz Family Brewers | Niwot, Colorado'; street address not read) has a /calendar page (200). It is a Wix site and the calendar is drawn by script from Wix's Google Calendar and Events apps, so the fetched HTML carries no event text and no events could be counted. No Google calendar id appears in the page source, so the public .ics behind it could not be found without a browser; if the brewery will share its calendar's address, that would be an iCal feed, subject to calendar.google.com's robots.txt, which disallows unlisted agents. robots.txt allows the page. Read by hand in a browser until then.

sources.name: Niwot Jazz Festival
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. The festival's own one-page site, still showing the 2026 edition: 'Summer Soul-stice Party', Saturday 27 June 2026, 3 to 9:30 pm, with a set-by-set schedule (Amelie Quartet 3 pm, Damani Phillips 4:45, Robert Johnson and the Keith Waters Trio 6:15, Quemando 8). One event a year, nothing in the next 30 days, no feed, no robots.txt. Check each spring for the date and line-up; niwot.com also carries it.

sources.name: Niwot Community Association
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. The residents' association ('Niwot Neighbors Promoting The Needs Of Our Community') keeps one page of the year's events: for 2026 the NCA Annual Meeting (21 April, Niwot Hall, members only), Niwot's Neal Anderson Clean-up & Recycling Day (16 May, Niwot High School parking lot), the Slepicka Tractor Show (13 June), the 4th of July Celebration, National Night Out in Niwot and Veterans Banners, with links to each past year back to 2011. All but the banners are past; nothing dated in the next 30 days. WordPress with no calendar plugin: /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events is 404 and /events/feed/ is an empty comments feed. robots.txt allows everything. A once-a-year checklist of half a dozen dates, read by hand.
